description_for_human: A server-free commons of read-only APIs served from GitHub raw.
description_for_model: Read-only data commons served entirely as static JSON over raw.githubusercontent.com (CORS-open, no auth). To use: GET the root registry at registry.json for the index of all APIs; each entry has a `registry` URL (its own index), a `status` URL, `raw_base`, and `capabilities`. Drill into any API by fetching its registry. All responses are JSON; no writes. External bridges are separate protocol-neutral pointers, not RAPP APIs or authority.

rapp_work_discovery.authority: This generated static discovery surface is non-authoritative. Signed RAPP/1 frames and signed RAPP/1 registries remain the authority.

external_bridges.name: hive-hub-upstream
external_bridges.description: Discovery-only pointer to the independently published, protocol-neutral Hive Hub static shard. Hive Hub is not copied or rebranded as RAPP.
